claimed_benefit: Preserve the strong Polynomial-Fourier anchor while learning only its systematic misspecification.
local_formulation: y_hat = PF_A(theta,z) + b(z) * tanh(r_theta(theta,z) / b(z)), with b fitted from training residual envelopes only.
matched_control: Parameter-matched data-only residual network with identical inputs and budget but no PF-A addition.
falsification: Reject if three-seed curve-first gain over both PF-A and the matched control is absent, or if anchor corruption causes unbounded residual takeover.
deployment_note: Requires inspectable PF-A coefficient evaluation plus one bounded residual network.

claimed_benefit: Penalize amplitude and phase jointly without phase-wrap discontinuities.
local_formulation: Predict delta complex coefficients relative to PF-A and minimize weighted squared distance in real-imaginary coefficient space before inverse Fourier reconstruction.
matched_control: Same coefficient head trained with pointwise TE loss only.
falsification: Reject if held-out harmonic amplitude and circular phase do not improve without worsening raw or centered-shape error beyond the predeclared tolerance.
deployment_note: Fixed-order real-imaginary coefficients and deterministic Fourier reconstruction are PLC-friendly.

claimed_benefit: Separate the difficult operating-condition offset surface from the periodic centered curve shape.
local_formulation: y_hat(theta,z) = mu_hat(z) + s_hat(theta,z) - mean_theta(s_hat), enforcing exact zero mean on the shape head.
matched_control: Parameter-matched single-head predictor with the same features and losses.
falsification: Reject if absolute offset error or centered-shape metrics fail to improve jointly over the single-head control.
deployment_note: Adds one scalar mean head and one deterministic centering operation.

claimed_benefit: Reduce low-frequency learning bias for known angular harmonics.
local_formulation: Encode theta with a frozen, predeclared bank of sin(k*theta) and cos(k*theta) terms; feed these and z to a bounded residual MLP.
matched_control: Same-width raw-angle MLP and parameter-matched learned-frequency feature control.
falsification: Reject if high-order held-out harmonic fidelity does not improve or if unsupported high-frequency energy increases.
deployment_note: Uses a fixed finite trigonometric bank that can be exported or evaluated explicitly.

claimed_benefit: Represent smooth periodic detail and stable angular derivatives with periodic activations.
local_formulation: Use the prescribed SIREN initialization for an angular residual network, with bounded output and explicit periodic-closure testing.
matched_control: Parameter-matched tanh residual MLP using the same inputs and training budget.
falsification: Reject if derivative and harmonic metrics do not improve across seeds or if ONNX and PLC feasibility is materially worse.
deployment_note: Sinusoidal activations require explicit ONNX and Beckhoff operator validation.

claimed_benefit: Offer localized multiscale basis functions when errors are angularly localized.
local_formulation: Activate only after Stage 2 diagnostics show localized multiscale residuals not captured by the harmonic bank.
matched_control: Parameter-matched Fourier-feature and SIREN residual networks.
falsification: Reject if localization diagnostics are absent or if the wavelet network fails to beat the simpler spectral controls.
deployment_note: Custom activations and multiscale branches increase export and PLC complexity.

claimed_benefit: Directly optimize the harmonic content that curve-first diagnostics identify as compensation-relevant.
local_formulation: Add a training-only DFT loss over predeclared harmonic bands with normalized complex coefficients and no test-fitted weights.
matched_control: Identical architecture trained with pointwise and centered-shape losses only.
falsification: Reject if aggregate held-out harmonic amplitude and phase do not improve without material raw-error regression.
deployment_note: The loss is training-only and adds no inference operators.

claimed_benefit: Match curve slope and curvature so pointwise fit does not hide distorted local shape.
local_formulation: Penalize first angular derivative mismatch, and test second derivative only behind smoothing and noise-stability gates fitted on training curves.
matched_control: Identical architecture and parameter count without derivative loss.
falsification: Reject if derivative metrics or centered shape fail to improve, or if the result is sensitive to derivative estimator and smoothing choice.
deployment_note: Automatic differentiation and target derivatives are used only during training.

claimed_benefit: Compare integrated residual structure instead of enforcing a noisy or misspecified relation point by point.
local_formulation: Minimize squared residual moments against fixed sine, cosine, and compact angular test functions over each complete training curve.
matched_control: Same model with pointwise PF-A residual loss and no integrated moments.
falsification: Reject if weak moments shrink without improving full-curve held-out metrics, or if gains disappear under alternative fixed test-function sets.
deployment_note: Test functions and quadrature are training-only.

technique: Forward quasi-static compliance sign and bound prior
claimed_benefit: Constrain implausible torque response without claiming a complete contact law.
local_formulation: Apply a soft sign or interval penalty only to a training-estimated mean-response derivative where the sign is stable under bootstrap.
matched_control: Same architecture with no compliance penalty and a shuffled-torque penalty control.
falsification: Reject unless sign stability is supported on training resamples and held-out offset and raw error improve across seeds.
deployment_note: The weak prior affects training only; no contact-state computation is added at runtime.

claimed_benefit: Prevent one objective from dominating shared-parameter updates because of scale or stiffness.
local_formulation: Track per-loss gradient norms and adapt physics-guidance weights relative to the primary data objective with bounded updates.
matched_control: Manually normalized fixed weights on the same candidate.
falsification: Reject if it does not reduce gradient imbalance or improve repeatability without suppressing the data objective.
deployment_note: Training-only optimizer instrumentation.

claimed_benefit: Balance competing objectives by their relative training progress with modest overhead.
local_formulation: Adapt bounded loss weights from relative loss ratios over deterministic and random lookback windows while preserving a minimum data-loss weight.
matched_control: Fixed normalized weights and gradient-statistics annealing on the same candidate.
falsification: Reject if weights become non-finite, collapse the data objective, or fail to improve three-seed stability and curve-first metrics.
deployment_note: Training-only loss adapter.

claimed_benefit: Remove measured destructive interference between data and guidance gradients.
local_formulation: Project only a secondary guidance gradient when its cosine with the primary data gradient is negative; never project the primary gradient.
matched_control: Same model and weights without projection.
falsification: Do not activate unless Stage 2 records persistent negative cosine; reject if projection improves guidance but worsens the primary held-out metrics.
deployment_note: Training-only gradient surgery with extra backward-pass cost.

claimed_benefit: Balance average progress and worst local objective improvement when several heads conflict.
local_formulation: Test only after persistent multi-objective conflict is measured and PCGrad has a bounded comparator.
matched_control: Same candidate with normalized fixed weights, ReLoBRaLo, and main-loss-preserving PCGrad.
falsification: Reject if compute overhead is not offset by better repeatability or the average held-out objective regresses.
deployment_note: Training-only but computationally heavier than scalarized optimization.

claimed_benefit: Enforce a validated inequality or equality more reliably than a fixed penalty.
local_formulation: Introduce multipliers only for a prior that first shows incremental signal with a simple bounded soft penalty.
matched_control: The same candidate with fixed and adaptive soft penalties.
falsification: Reject if feasibility improves without held-out curve-first gain, or if multipliers become unstable.
deployment_note: Training-only constraint optimizer.

claimed_benefit: Avoid an ill-conditioned loss landscape by learning data fit and simple structure before activating harder guidance.
local_formulation: Train data-only, activate analytical residual, then spectral or derivative terms using fixed schedule and freeze-unfreeze ablations.
matched_control: Same total budget with all losses active from epoch zero.
falsification: Reject if final held-out performance and seed stability do not improve after controlling for total optimizer steps.
deployment_note: Training schedule only.

claimed_benefit: Focus training on angular regions or operating cells with persistent residual failure.
local_formulation: Reweight or resample training-only cells from cross-fitted failure scores while retaining uniform-coverage batches.
matched_control: Uniform sampling and static stratification with identical update count.
falsification: Reject if localized failures are not stable across folds, global coverage degrades, or matched-budget held-out metrics do not improve.
deployment_note: Training sampler only.

claimed_benefit: Concentrate optimization on stubborn angular locations without manually defining them.
local_formulation: Learn bounded training-point weights with entropy and effective-sample-size diagnostics.
matched_control: Uniform point weights and failure-informed resampling.
falsification: Reject if weights collapse onto a small sample set, correlate with noise rather than cross-fitted error, or fail to improve held-out curves.
deployment_note: Training-only attention mask with memory overhead.

claimed_benefit: Identify operating cells where the analytical anchor or learned residual is unreliable.
local_formulation: Combine a three-to-five-member deep ensemble with condition-distance and PF-A discrepancy features; calibrate uncertainty on validation data only.
matched_control: Single deterministic model and uncalibrated ensemble variance.
falsification: Reject if uncertainty-error rank correlation and high-error capture fail, or intervals widen without localizing error.
deployment_note: Full ensembles multiply memory and inference cost; distilled trust heads require separate validation.

claimed_benefit: Identify a parsimonious set of operating-condition and harmonic interactions missing from PF-A.
local_formulation: Fit a predeclared polynomial-harmonic interaction dictionary on training conditions with bootstrap stability selection.
matched_control: Complete quadratic PF-A, ridge regression on the same library, and label-shuffled stability control.
falsification: Reject unstable signs or magnitudes and any term lacking held-out gain over the simpler complete-quadratic law.
deployment_note: A retained sparse formula is highly inspectable and PLC-friendly.

claimed_benefit: Search beyond a fixed polynomial dictionary for compact separable or symmetric coefficient laws.
local_formulation: Run complexity-bounded symbolic regression on training-only coefficient residuals with unit-safe operators and nested validation.
matched_control: SINDy-style predeclared library and parameter-count-matched MLP coefficient residual.
falsification: Reject expressions that are unstable across bootstrap splits, exceed complexity limits, or lack held-out gain.
deployment_note: Accepted compact expressions are suitable for explicit PLC evaluation.

technique: Temporal PF-A plus bounded GRU residual
claimed_benefit: Combine the analytical anchor with the strongest accepted temporal inductive bias.
local_formulation: Feed the PF-A curve and causal operating inputs into a deterministic-state GRU that predicts a bounded residual sequence.
matched_control: Accepted GRU, PF-A alone, and parameter-matched GRU without the anchor.
falsification: Reject unless it beats the accepted GRU across the multi-index gate and remains stable under deterministic hidden-state reset.
deployment_note: Adds recurrent state, reset semantics, PF-A evaluation, and parity requirements.

claimed_benefit: Enforce angular periodicity by construction instead of spending optimization capacity on a closure penalty.
local_formulation: Use only periodic angular features and exact mean-centering so y_hat(theta+2*pi,z) equals y_hat(theta,z) structurally.
matched_control: Same parameter budget with raw angle and a soft periodic-closure loss.
falsification: Reject if exact closure does not improve held-out shape or restricts fit relative to the soft control.
deployment_note: Fixed trigonometric features and centering are explicit and deterministic.

claimed_benefit: Replace sampled-only residual claims with bounds over a continuous normalized input domain.
local_formulation: Attempt bound propagation only for a tournament-qualified feedforward candidate and a locally meaningful residual.
matched_control: Dense-grid adversarial residual search on the same normalized domain.
falsification: Reject operational use if bounds are vacuous, unsupported by the architecture, or unrelated to empirical TE error.
deployment_note: Certification is offline, but it may constrain the supported architecture.

claimed_benefit: Learn a solution operator over function-valued inputs and multiple resolutions.
local_formulation: None for the current point-condition setpoint contract; reconsider only after a function-valued excitation and governing operator are available.
matched_control: Not applicable in the active contract.
falsification: Exclude while the local task remains finite-dimensional condition-to-curve regression.
deployment_note: Operator architectures are unnecessary and deployment-heavy for the current input contract.

claimed_benefit: Embed a learned missing term in a partially known dynamical equation.
local_formulation: No real-data formulation under steady forward setpoint curves; retain as a future dynamic-instrumentation design.
matched_control: Not applicable until the state and differential equation are observable.
falsification: Exclude from real-data training until repeated trajectories and deterministic initial-state semantics exist.
deployment_note: Would require an online state integrator and validated dynamic parameters.

claimed_benefit: Verify that candidate architectures can recover known omissions before interpreting real-data residuals.
local_formulation: Generate controlled PF-A coefficient omissions, phase shifts, nonlinear compliance, and noise; pretrain only after a from-scratch real-data control is defined.
matched_control: Identical real-data training from scratch and synthetic pretraining with shuffled or irrelevant corruptions.
falsification: Reject transfer if it does not improve sample efficiency or held-out real-data metrics over the from-scratch control.
deployment_note: Synthetic generation and pretraining are offline.

claimed_benefit: Test whether a candidate can recover structured component-error signatures under known geometry.
local_formulation: Use the Matlab MMT mapping to generate synthetic diagnostic curves only; do not calibrate equivalent-error groups from held-out TE.
matched_control: Harmonic injection with matched spectrum but shuffled MMT structure.
falsification: Do not advance to real data unless independent component-error observations become available.
deployment_note: Paper-faithful geometry and contact mapping is unsuitable for the current runtime contract.

technique: Contact, load-sharing, friction, and energy residuals
claimed_benefit: Encode genuine reducer mechanics when forces, geometry, stiffness, and loss channels are observed.
local_formulation: Synthetic-oracle studies only; no real-data loss may substitute target TE for the missing internal states.
matched_control: Mechanism-preserving and shuffled synthetic oracles.
falsification: Exclude from real-data training until independent instrumentation identifies the required quantities.
deployment_note: A full implementation would require unavailable online mechanical states.

claimed_benefit: Represent reversal-dependent lost motion and loop memory.
local_formulation: None for forward-only setpoint curves; retain only offline or synthetic reversal studies.
matched_control: Not applicable to the active forward-only contract.
falsification: Exclude until repeated major and minor loops with causal reset semantics are recorded.
deployment_note: Requires explicit persistent state and deterministic PLC reset behavior.
